# Certiplot

> Property checks for buyers in Greece and Cyprus. Certiplot puts the official public records about an area in one place - the State's zone price, what contracts there declared, building permits issued nearby, flood-risk and burnt land, Natura 2000 and seismic zones - with the source of every figure, so your questions to the seller, your lawyer and your engineer start from proof.

Certiplot (a Tekmerion product, Athens) publishes, for every region and municipality of Greece and every district and municipality of Cyprus, the official public figures a property buyer should check: the State's zone price, contract prices, official price indices, flood-risk and burnt land, Natura 2000 and seismic zones - each with its source and date. It is information, not legal advice.

Languages: English, Ελληνικά, Deutsch, Français, Nederlands, Español, Русский, العربية.

Contact: codeforgerpro@gmail.com

## Guides

- [How to buy property in Greece: the step-by-step guide for foreign buyers](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/how-to-buy-property-in-greece/): Buying a house or apartment in Greece as a foreigner, step by step: tax number, bank account, title check, Cadastre, engineer's certificate, energy certificate, price and signing.
- [The costs of buying property in Greece: what to budget for](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/costs-of-buying-property-in-greece/): Every cost a buyer in Greece should budget for, one by one: transfer tax or VAT, notary, lawyer, Cadastre registration, agent, engineer, and the yearly property tax.
- [Greek tax number (AFM) and bank account for foreign buyers](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/greek-tax-number-afm-for-foreigners/): Why a foreign buyer needs a Greek tax number (AFM) and bank account, how to get them in person or through a lawyer, and what to have ready.
- [Title check in Greece: how to verify who owns a property](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/greek-property-title-check/): What a title search in Greece covers, which certificates prove ownership and the absence of mortgages or seizures, and the warning signs a buyer should not ignore.
- [Unauthorised construction in Greece and the engineer's certificate](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/illegal-buildings-engineer-certificate-greece/): Why a Greek sale needs an engineer's certificate, what counts as unauthorised construction, how it is legalised, and what a buyer should ask before signing.
- [The Hellenic Cadastre (Ktimatologio) and the KAEK explained](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/hellenic-cadastre-ktimatologio-kaek/): What the Hellenic Cadastre records, how to find a property's KAEK on the public map, the documents it issues and the errors a buyer should look for.
- [Mortgages, seizures and other encumbrances on Greek property](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/property-encumbrances-greece-mortgage-seizure/): The encumbrances that can sit on a Greek property, how a buyer finds them, and how they are lifted before or at the contract.
- [Zone price (objective value) vs market price in Greece](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/zone-price-objective-value-vs-market-price-greece/): What the Greek zone price is, why it is not a market price, how it affects the tax you pay, and how to read it next to contract prices and the official index.
- [Building permits near a property: what is being built next door](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/building-permits-near-property-greece/): How to see the building permits issued around a property in Greece, and why new construction next door matters for views, light, noise and value.
- [Golden Visa Greece: a property checklist before you invest](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/golden-visa-greece-property-checklist/): What to check on a property bought for the Greek Golden Visa: the threshold for the address, the title, the engineer's certificate, the real value and the risks of the area.
- [Buying in Cyprus: title deeds and the search certificate](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/cyprus-title-deeds-search-certificate/): Why separate title deeds matter in Cyprus, what the Lands Office search certificate shows, why the sale contract is deposited, and what to check near the buffer zone.
- [Buying property in Cyprus as a foreigner: permission, steps and checks](https://codeforgerpro-collab.github.io/certiplot-site/guides/buying-property-in-cyprus-as-a-foreigner/): How EU and non-EU buyers acquire property in Cyprus: the permission non-EU buyers need, the steps from reservation to transfer, and what to verify first.
